import z3

n = 12
X = [[z3.Int(f'x{i}_{j}') for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

s = z3.Solver()

# Domain constraints
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        s.add(X[i][j] >= 0, X[i][j] < n)

# Idempotent
for i in range(n):
    s.add(X[i][i] == i)

# Latin square: rows and columns are permutations
for i in range(n):
    s.add(z3.Distinct(X[i]))
    col = [X[k][i] for k in range(n)]
    s.add(z3.Distinct(col))

# QG3: for all i,j, X[ X[i][j] ][ X[j][i] ] == i
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        s.add(X[ X[i][j] ][ X[j][i] ] == i )

print(s.check())
if s.check() == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    grid = [[m.eval(X[i][j]).as_long() for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    flat = [grid[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)]
    print(flat)
